facts.fact: StackAdapt announced new CTV advancements, including CTV Properties and creative transcoding, in a press release dated April 15, 2025.
facts.quote: **TORONTO – April 15, 2025**– StackAdapt (www.stackadapt.com), the leading multi-channel programmatic advertising platform

facts.fact: StackAdapt's creative transcoding solution for CTV ads is offered at no cost to advertisers, according to StackAdapt.
facts.quote: StackAdapt’s transcoding solution simplifies this process at no cost, ensuring seamless activation across premium inventory

facts.fact: According to eMarketer as cited by StackAdapt, nearly $90 billion in ad revenue is expected from CTV and linear TV by 2028.
facts.quote: [nearly $90 billion in ad revenue](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/ctv-opportunity) is expected from CTV and linear TV by 2028

facts.fact: According to eMarketer as cited by StackAdapt, CTV is expected to approach half of the total CTV and linear TV ad revenue market by 2028.
facts.quote: with CTV approaching half of the total market.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it is rated the number 1 demand-side platform (DSP) on G2.
facts.quote: is rated [the number 1 demand-side platform (DSP)](https://www.stackadapt.com/best-demand-side-platform-dsp) on G2

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it is used by thousands of brands and agencies around the world.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a multi-channel programmatic advertising platform used by thousands of brands and agencies around the world.
